title: 第二章 硬要加入群聊
slug: 纨绔女修四处撩绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

025把自己泡在灵力里，美美充电一整晚，刚神清气爽得开机，就正对上一双死气沉沉的熊猫眼，差点被吓乱码。

【祖宗，你昨天晚上背着我偷鸡去了？】

萧姚小心地把最后一颗留影石镶进机械小蜜蜂里，才伸了个懒腰，打着哈欠：

【祖宗，你把倒计时关了，我就睡。】

看着364天3小时，她真睡不着。

025盯着萧姚手里振翅的小蜜蜂，稀奇地“咦”了一声：

【宿主，这啥？你做的摄像头？】

萧姚轻哼一声：

【哼哼，纯手搓平替。】

萧姚用虚浮的灵力操纵着，让小蜜蜂在头顶滞空，只坚持了不到三秒钟，萧姚就吐着舌头趴在桌子上喘气。

小蜜蜂瞬间像抽空灵力的废铁，吧唧一声掉在地上。

025：……菜鸡宿主。

萧姚把一桌子的小蜜蜂拢在一起，往椅背上一瘫。

【统子，航拍的事就交给你咯。】

【啊？我吗？？】

萧姚理直气壮：

【我是丹药堆出来的菜鸡，您是神通广大的系统，能力越强责任越大。】

【025大人，小的相信你哦~】

025的嘴角越来越难压，高高兴兴得出去布控完，确保没有监控死角后，才后知后觉：

【淦！你pua我！】

【您所呼叫的用户已失联，请不要再联系。】

萧姚在脑海里听到025抓狂的电子音时，人刚刚被扔出核心区域。

两分钟前，她身穿外门弟子服饰，戴了一顶宽沿帽，在脸上抹了点粉修了下眉形眼形，准备十分充足。

结果出师未捷。她脚还没踩进传送阵，就被葛长老黑着脸拎出内门范围。

萧姚随意拍拍屁股上的土，直奔外门弟子经常出没的岔路口而去。

行呗，她没办法在大典上找人，那她就在外围蹲守，碰到一个查一个。

她相信，昨天盯着她的人，会自己送上门来的。

萧姚一边腹诽，一边爬上大树，四处寻找目标。

这个尖嘴猴腮，排除。

这个身宽体胖，也排除……

萧姚换了个姿势准备继续找反派突然耳朵一动，遥望向远方。

“万剑宗这次就来了两位峰主，一个年轻俊杰都没带，明显是被萧姚恶心到了。”

“可不是嘛，乐修世家直接连回函都没回，面子活儿都不做了。”

“我要是有这样不成器的女儿，早一把掐死了嘻嘻。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

025 soaked himself in the spiritual power and charged it all night long. As soon as he turned on the phone feeling refreshed, he was faced with a pair of lifeless panda eyes, which almost frightened him into garbled words.

[Ancestor, did you steal the chicken behind my back last night?】

Xiao Yao carefully set the last image stone into the mechanical bee, then stretched and yawned:

[Ancestor, please turn off the countdown and I will go to sleep.】

Watching 364 days and 3 hours, she really couldn't sleep.

025 stared at the little bee flapping its wings in Xiao Yao's hand, and said "Hey" strangely:

[Host, what is this?Did you make the camera?】

Xiao Yao snorted:

[Hmph, just rub it with your hands.】

Xiao Yao used his imaginary spiritual power to control the little bee in the air above his head. It only lasted for less than three seconds, and Xiao Yao lay on the table with his tongue hanging out and panting.

The little bee instantly fell to the ground with a chirping sound like scrap metal that had been drained of its spiritual power.

025: ...rookie host.

Xiao Yao gathered the little bees on the table together and slumped back on the chair.

[Tongzi, I’ll leave the aerial photography to you.】

【ah?Me??】

Xiao Yao said confidently:

[I am a rookie who came from a pile of pills. You are a system with great power. The greater the ability, the greater the responsibility.】

【025 Sir, I believe you~】

The corner of 025's mouth became increasingly difficult to suppress. He happily went out to complete the control and ensured that there were no blind spots in surveillance, and then he realized later:

【Gan!You pua me!】

[The user you called has lost contact, please do not contact us again.】

When Xiao Yao heard the crazy electronic sound of 025 in his mind, he had just been thrown out of the core area.

Two minutes ago, she was wearing the clothes of an outer disciple and a wide-brimmed hat. She put some powder on her face and reshaped her eyebrows and eyes. She was very well prepared.

The result was a failure.Before she even stepped into the teleportation array, Elder Ge carried her out of the inner gate with a dark face.

Xiao Yao casually patted the dirt on his butt and headed straight for the fork in the road where outer disciples often go.

Okay, she couldn't find anyone at the ceremony, so she would just wait outside and check everyone she met.

She believed that the person who was staring at her yesterday would come to her door on her own.

Xiao Yao cursed as he climbed up the tree and looked around for the target.

This sharp-mouthed monkey cheek is excluded.

This wide body and fat body also rule out...

Xiao Yao changed his posture and was about to continue looking for the villain. Suddenly his ears twitched and he looked into the distance.

"Two peak masters from Wanjian Sect came this time, and they didn't bring any young heroes with them. They were obviously disgusted by Xiao Yao."

"Isn't that right? The Lexiu family didn't even reply to the letter, and they didn't even do any honorable work."

"If I had such a useless daughter, I would have strangled her to death a long time ago, hehe."
